english_concat: We are commanded to search the Scriptures: in order that this may be done rightly, it must first be understood which are the genuine books of the Scriptures, with which in searching and studying we ought to be occupied. english_concat: We are commanded to search the Scriptures: in which it must next be seen to whom this precept was given — whether only to the learned and those skilled in the languages, or to all the pious. reference: We are commanded to search the scriptures: and therefore we must next consider, to whom this precept is addressed ; whether only to the learned, and those skilled in the ancient languages, or to all the faithful. english_concat: And when Christ commanded without exception that the sacred Scriptures be searched— not only these, or those, or certain of them— it is plain that by these words it is prescribed that we search all of them, and that we should not, clinging to certain parts of the Scriptures, despise or pass over the rest. For all of them give no obscure testimony to Christ.
reference: Now since Christ hath bid us search the scriptures without exception, not this part, or that part, or the other, it is mani- fest that in these words we are commanded to search the whole of scripture; not to confine ourselves to certain portions of it, while we despise or overlook the rest. latin_concat: diſtribui poſſe iudicamus. Iubemur Scripturas ſcru- tari: quod vt rectè fiat, primùm intelligendum eſt, quinam illi ſint Scripturarum libri genuini, in qui- bus ſcrutandis & verſandis nos occupatos eſſe opor- teat. Ergo hæc erit prima quæſtio, De numero Canoni- corum librorum Scripturæ.
english_concat: We are commanded to search the Scriptures: and in order that this be rightly done, it must first be understood which are those genuine books of the Scriptures, in searching and handling which we ought to be occupied. Therefore this will be the first question, "On the Number of the Canonical Books of Scripture."
reference: We are commanded to search the scriptures : and for that purpose we must first understand, what are those genuine books of scripture, in searching and turning over which it behoves us to be occupied. The first question therefore shall be, Of the num- ber of the canonical books of scripture.

latin_concat: Iubemur Scripturas ſcrutari: in quo proximè vi- dendum eſt, quibus hoc præceptum fuerit, vtrum doctis tantùm & linguarum peritis,an piis omnibus. Ergo ſecunda queſtio erit,De Scripturarum verſionibus, ſacrisq́ vernaculis.
english_concat: We are commanded to search the Scriptures: in which the next thing to be seen is to whom this command was given—whether only to the learned and those skilled in languages, or to all the pious. Therefore the second question will be, "On Versions of the Scriptures, and on Vernacular Sacred Writings."
reference: We are commanded to search the scriptures: and therefore we must next consider, to whom this precept is addressed ; whether only to the learned, and those skilled in the ancient languages, or to all the faithful. The second question therefore shall be, Of versions of the scripture and sacred rites in the vulgar tongue.

latin_concat: Iubemur Scripturas ſcrutari: ex quo manifeſtum eſt, ſcripturas dignitate atque authoritate ſumma præditas eſſe, quando ad eas nos Chriſtus ipſe reuo- cat ac remittit. Ergo tertia quæſtio erit, De authorita- te Scripturæ, vtrùm hanc tantam fidem atque dignita- tem ex ſe habeat, ſuoque authore Spiritu ſancto, an ex Eccleſiæ teſtimonio.
english_concat: We are commanded to search the Scriptures: from which it is plain that the Scriptures are endowed with the highest dignity and authority, since Christ himself calls and sends us back to them. Therefore the third question will be, "On the Authority of Scripture"—whether it has this great credit and dignity from itself, and from its author the Holy Spirit, or from the testimony of the Church.
reference: We are commanded to search the scriptures : whence it appears that the scriptures enjoy a very high dignity and authority, since Christ himself appeals and refers us to them. The third question therefore shall be, Of the authority of scripture; whether it have this so great credibility and dignity of itself, and from the Holy Ghost its author, or from the testimony of the church.
